user.title: Connect Panasonic Comfort Cloud
user.description: Experimental cloud integration. Monitoring is enabled first; AC controls can be enabled in options. Use an account with access to your own devices. Your password and one-time code are not saved.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew Panasonic sign-in
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in to the same account. Existing entities and options will be retained.

mfa.title: Panasonic verification code
mfa.description: Enter the one-time code requested by Panasonic's current sign-in challenge.

error.invalid_auth: Sign in failed or the session was revoked. Check the account in the official app.
error.agreements_required: Review and accept Panasonic's updated agreements in the official Comfort Cloud app, then retry.
error.app_version: Panasonic rejected the app protocol version. Set the current Comfort Cloud app version in this sign-in form and retry.
error.rate_limit: Panasonic is limiting requests. Wait before trying again.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Panasonic. Check the connection and try later.
error.protocol_error: Panasonic returned an unsupported response. Check the official app and open an issue with redacted diagnostics.
error.mfa_retry: The verification challenge could not be completed. Sign in again to request a fresh challenge.
error.stale_too_short: Maximum age must be at least twice the status interval.

abort.already_configured: This Panasonic account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Use the same Panasonic account as this integration.

init.title: Polling, diagnostics and AC controls
init.description: Longer intervals reduce account throttling. Unknown raw sensors have no assumed units. Control support is experimental and AC only.

data.raw_sensors: Discover extra raw numeric sensors (disabled initially)
